live_outlet.method: 40m/s straight outlet,30Hz accepted presentation,640x360 orthographic6m camera following an opaque green nozzle marker. One process_frame+frame_post_draw per interval; immediate get_image after frame30, no extra/no-request settling frames. Red smoke sampled aft of marker in that same draw; near zone0.3m aft and16px high; red threshold R-max(G,B)>0.015.
live_outlet.ordering_tradeoff: Lifetime order uses current instances but is not view-dependent or global alpha sorting. The comparison overrides only a disposable v2 fixture to reproduce the former Compatibility history policy.

motion.method: Orthographic640x360 camera.size6m; color-channel range weights isolate red smoke from gray background; projected image centroid, not hidden3D positions. Eight no-new-request draws drain the last accepted GPU command before readback.
motion.scope: One native backend, single-side projection; not fleet continuity or full3D plume qualification.

ordering_views.method: Controlled opposing directional lights; two stationary opposing outlets using the same smooth red/blue/yellow palette with0.1s phaseoffset;2s acceptedtime. Opposing orthographicviews after8no-requestdraws freezeidenticalplumestate for informational orderingcomparison. Same seeds/profile for both drawpolicies.
ordering_views.scope: Capture assertions establish visibility only. These images do not establish global alpha-order correctness for arbitrary crossing plumes, canopies, water or cameras.

scope: Native GLES3 compile/render/lifecycle probe; not a frame-time or physical validation campaign.
